workflow.title: Production workflow
workflow.subtitle: Design, version, and publish factory stage paths
workflow.futureOrdersOnly: This will affect future production orders only.

errors.WORKFLOW_NO_ROOT: The workflow has no starting stage.
errors.WORKFLOW_NO_TERMINAL: The workflow has no finishing stage.

workflow.simpleSubtitle: Create stage paths for your products, then assign them from product details.
workflow.newWorkflowHint: Name the workflow in English, Arabic, and Hebrew. You can add stages next.
workflow.deleteWorkflowConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Products using it will be unassigned. Past orders keep their snapshot.
workflow.emptyWorkflowHint: Start with a new workflow, then add stages in order.
workflow.stagesHint: Stages run top to bottom. Optional stages can be skipped on an order.

workflow.productSectionHint: Pick which workflow this product uses when orders are confirmed.
workflow.placementHint: Choose where this stage sits in the path.
workflow.chartPreviewHint: Path preview — same circle map used in production.

workflow.connectionHint: Leave Runs after empty to put this at the start. Leave Leads into empty to connect to the last stage — or become the new last stage if this runs after it.
workflow.runsAfterEmptyHint: Optional — empty means this is a starting stage.
workflow.leadsIntoEmptyHint: Optional — empty connects to the last stage, unless this runs after the last stage (then it becomes the new end).
workflow.disconnectedHint: No links selected — this stage won’t connect until you edit it.
workflow.willBecomeLast: This will become the new last stage.
workflow.saveConnectionsError: Couldn't save those connections — try again.
workflow.discardConfirm: Leave without publishing? Unpublished edits to this workflow will be discarded.
workflow.unpublishedHint: Changes are draft only — publish to keep them, or leave to discard.
